comparison.objective: Mount and screw two snowboard bindings into a specified stance; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part pose alignment and repeated screw driving versus fine guide-slot insertion, tang depression, and opposing wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both bindings aligned and clamped by driven screws; candidate requires designated-contact removal with neighbors retained and housing reusable. Candidate force thresholds are unmeasured.
comparison.reason: Screw-fastened binding installation does not test selective depinning.
